demand_high: City and district trip-demand paths ramp from 0% deviation in 2024 to +10% in 2030.
demand_low: City and district trip-demand paths ramp from 0% deviation in 2024 to -10% in 2030.
fiscal_adverse: Municipal budget, GDP and household income ramp to -20%, while transport fuel, electricity and OPEX inputs ramp to +20%, by 2030.
fiscal_favorable: Municipal budget, GDP and household income ramp to +20%, while transport fuel, electricity and OPEX inputs ramp to -20%, by 2030.
